items.title: Hormuz oil flows rise under US Navy escort but remain below prewar levels
items.title_zh: 美海军护航下霍尔木兹油运回升，仍低于战前水平
items.summary_zh: 美国能源部长赖特称，在美军协调保护下，霍尔木兹海峡七日均油运升至约每天1100万桶，为数月高位，但仍低于战前约1500万桶。中央司令部称自5月以来已协助约1600艘船、逾8亿桶原油通过；与此同时佩里姆易手令“南线替代”叙事更脆弱。

quotes.author: Chris Wright / Stars and Stripes
quotes.en: Just under 11 million barrels of oil daily are transiting the Strait of Hormuz on a seven-day average… Still, the latest figure was short of the prewar average of about 15 million barrels per day.
quotes.zh: 霍尔木兹海峡七日均油运略低于每天1100万桶……但这一数字仍短于战前约每天1500万桶的平均水平。

items.title: Make your first edit to OpenStreetMap
items.title_zh: 完成你在OpenStreetMap上的第一次编辑
items.summary_zh: 教程引导新人用JOSM插件向导完成首次OSM编辑。贡献者分享用GPX测绘新建骑行道、以及推荐Every Door等更友好入门工具的经验；开源地图仍靠地面真相续命。近580赞。

quotes.author: _russross
quotes.en:
I started contributing to OSM recently after a bike trail was built near me. The arial imagery typically takes years to refresh around here so I walked it a few times to capture GPX tracks and then drew the new path. It was exciting to see my contribution percolate out to various apps that depend on OSM, and meanwhile Google and Apple have both ignored my edit suggestions and deny the path exists.
So I have a fairly fresh newcomer's perspective and here's what I suggest to…
quotes.zh: 我家附近修了骑行道后我开始贡献OSM。这边航拍影像通常要好几年才更新，所以我走了几次采GPX轨迹再画上去。

quotes.author: celsoazevedo
quotes.en:
This seems to be a very powerful way to contribute to OpenStreetMap, but I'm not sure if it's the right option for a new user.
I have over 2k contributions and most are from the Every Door app ( https://every-door.app/ ) on my phone.
If adding new data is too "scary", then maybe use StreetComplete ( https://streetcomplete.app/ ) which essentially asks questions about missing or existing old data.
I've added buildings, fixed layouts, etc, but that came later, after I better…
quotes.zh: 这看起来是贡献OpenStreetMap的强大方式，但我不确定对新用户是不是最佳选择。我有两千多次贡献，大多来自Every Door应用。

items.title: Saudi airstrikes hit Mocha airport after Houthi coastal advance
items.title_zh: 胡塞夺岸后沙特空袭穆哈机场
items.summary_zh: 美联社报道，沙特在胡塞夺取穆哈并推进至海峡岛屿后，空袭了穆哈机场；胡塞电视台率先披露，暂无伤亡细节。伊朗同步呼吁结束沙特对也门封锁，公开站队盟友。空袭被解读为利雅得在“求美直接出兵未果”后的有限示强。

quotes.author: AP / The Hill
quotes.en: Saudi Arabia responded with airstrikes against the airport in the key port city of Mokha that the Houthis seized on Thursday, a Houthi broadcaster said.
quotes.zh: 胡塞广播称，沙特对胡塞周四夺取的要港穆哈的机场实施了空袭回应。

items.title: Nvidia is the central bank of AI
items.summary_zh: 《经济学人》互动稿把英伟达比作AI时代的“央行”：算力配额、投资承诺与估值叙事绑定。评论拿美联储资产负债表开玩笑对比，并指出OpenAI/Anthropic公开喊减速或许意味着边际效用见顶。约550赞。

quotes.author: JumpCrisscross
quotes.en:
> worth around $5.4trn
Note that the Fed has a $6.7tn balance sheet [1]. (This is a silly comparison. But still fun.)
The real comparison: Nvidia's $500+ billion of investments and commitments [2] is substantially more than any easing the Fed has done in the same time [3]. Monetarily, Nvidia is creating a lot of money in our economy.
The good news: I have seen no evidence Nvidia has borrowed against its stock or otherwise linked its equity value to these commitments. Its…
quotes.zh: 文中写市值约5.4万亿美元。注意美联储资产负债表有6.7万亿。这是个傻对比，但好玩。真正该比的是英伟达五千亿美元量级的投资与承诺。

quotes.author: anu7df
quotes.en: Cracks are starting to appear. Open Ai and Anthropic are publicly asking for slowdown in AI research. Translation: We see this technology not being any more useful than what it is now, no AGI is coming, and the first one to accept this and slow down the dollar burn rate will incur the wrath of the market. So let's say this big boogey man technology will end all life on earth and we all slow down together. Bonus points if we can lobby for this to be included in the national…
quotes.zh: 裂缝开始出现。OpenAI和Anthropic公开要求放慢AI研究。翻译：我们觉得这技术不会比现在更有用了，没有AGI要来……

items.title: Yemeni government vows counter-offensive to retake Mocha approaches
items.title_zh: 也门政府军扬言反攻：要夺回穆哈接近路径
items.summary_zh: 国际承认的也门政府军表示将动用武器与飞机，清除穆哈沿海战略区及通往该港道路上的胡塞动向，力图收复本周闪电丢失的红海沿岸地带。分析指若佩里姆—杜巴卜一线巩固，政府军反攻窗口会迅速收窄。

quotes.author: Reuters
quotes.en: Yemeni government forces indicated they would try to retake areas captured by the Houthis… They announced they would deploy weapons and aircraft to eliminate any movement of the 'terrorist' Houthi militias in strategic areas, including the road leading to Mocha.
quotes.zh: 也门政府军表示将试图收复被胡塞占领的地区……并宣布将部署武器与飞机，清除包括通往穆哈道路在内的战略区胡塞动向。

items.title: A Design Space Exploration of Async/Await
items.title_zh: Async/Await的设计空间勘探：九个维度
items.summary_zh: 布朗大学CEL博客从语义出发比较异步运行时的九个设计维度。评论称异步看似“只是语法糖”，实则隐藏取消、调度与错误传播等根本取舍；呼吁更多语言对照研究。约450赞。

quotes.author: biorach
quotes.en:
It's long been clear that there were fundamental implementation choices that mattered between async runtimes, but _nine_ design dimensions? Damn.
I think async is deceptive in that it seems like a self-contained and relatively straightforward aspect of a language. But there are many design choices to be made and they all have wide implications.
Plus I think the implications of many of these dimensions are not fully understood and that collectively we are still trying to…
quotes.zh: 大家早就清楚异步运行时之间有根本实现选择在起作用，但居然有九个设计维度？异步很骗人，看起来像只是……

quotes.author: cpa
quotes.en:
This kind of semantics-first comparative analysis of programming languages is so important.
I had a course at uni where we dissected how different languages approached concurrency, parallelism, modules/OOP, metaprogramming, eager vs lazy evaluation, types, exceptions... Understanding the trade-offs each language made (and their historical lineage) taught me much more about programming than any Python/Java/C course and made it much easier to pick up new languages.
quotes.zh: 这种语义优先的编程语言比较分析太重要了。大学时有门课拆解不同语言如何处理并发、并行与模块……

items.title: Oil on track to end week above $100 as dual-strait squeeze deepens
items.title_zh: 双海峡挤压加深，油价有望整周收在100美元上方
items.summary_zh: 路透社称周五油价虽有回落，但仍有望录得自5月中旬以来首次整周收在每桶100美元上方。佩里姆易手与沙特管线关停叠加，使“霍尔木兹+曼德”双海峡叙事从交易员黑话变成盘面主线；盘中一度逼近110美元。

quotes.author: Reuters
quotes.en: Oil prices dipped on Friday but were on track to end the week above $100 a barrel for the first time since mid-May.
quotes.zh: 周五油价有所回落，但仍有望以每桶100美元上方结束本周——这是自5月中旬以来首次。

items.title: Linux Zoom client proactively reading everything written to X11 clipboard
items.title_zh: Linux版Zoom主动读取写入X11剪贴板的一切
items.summary_zh: 安全研究者指出Linux Zoom客户端会主动读取X11剪贴板内容。评论回忆Zoom在macOS上的历史特权问题，并建议尽量用浏览器版；桌面客户端的暗黑诱导再次被点名。近390赞。

quotes.author: rmellow
quotes.en:
Not the first time Zoom abuses privilege.
A few years back, there was something about gaining root on MacOS via Zoom due to shady execution on their end.
They've lost my trust since then, and I'll only run it sandboxed:  https://gist.github.com/cielavenir/02f322e322a2a3555dbf2b38f...
I always ask (1) why does an app require installation and (2) why would it require root?
There are valid answers for both, but realistically, all a videoconferencing app should need (apart from…
quotes.zh: 这不是Zoom第一次滥用权限。几年前就有过靠可疑执行在macOS上拿到root之类的事。从那以后我就不信任他们了，只会……

quotes.author: Arbortheus
quotes.en: Just run these things in your browser. Despite the dark design patterns that try to trick you into installing their desktop client, the web-based versions are fine.
quotes.zh: 这些东西放浏览器里跑就行。别管那些诱导你装桌面客户端的暗黑设计，网页版其实够用。

items.title: Arctic strike aftermath: Yamal LNG risk premium stays in European gas
items.title_zh: 北极打击余波：欧洲气价仍定价亚马尔LNG风险溢价
items.summary_zh: 继乌克兰无人机打击亚马尔—涅涅茨凝析气设施后，9月11日分析继续聚焦：下一步若波及萨贝塔港或亚马尔LNG航运，将在霍尔木兹已阻滞约五分之一全球LNG贸易的背景下进一步抽紧市场。欧洲基准气价本周已站上80欧元/兆瓦时上方。

quotes.author: bne IntelliNews
quotes.en: Any disruption at Yamal LNG would further tighten the global gas supply, which has already become significantly strained by the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.
quotes.zh: 亚马尔LNG若出现任何中断，将使本已因霍尔木兹封锁而显著承压的全球天然气供应更紧。

items.title: Apple iPod Engraver (2019)
items.summary_zh: 复盘苹果官网曾为iPod提供的个性化雕刻体验原型。评论怀念“给网站加一点交互火花”的岗位；另有人分享在QEMU里跑iPod Classic 6G固件、模拟点击轮的业余项目。约280赞。

quotes.author: georgecalm
quotes.en: I really appreciate that someone's job (or at least part of it) was to "prototype concepts that would add some interactive sparkle to the site". Working on a larger team, we generally add this kind of interaction at the start of a project or during redesign. There are larger prototypes, of course. But very rarely is someone designated to independently go out and just find small ways of making the experience just a bit nicer for the users, and build that; and I really like…
quotes.zh: 我真的很欣赏有人的工作（至少一部分）是“原型化能给网站加点交互火花的概念”。在大团队里，我们通常会把这种……

quotes.author: dmcrespo
quotes.en:
Since this is about old iPod technology, I thought this might be interesting here:
I’ve been working on getting the real Apple iPod Classic 6G firmware running in QEMU. It currently emulates two clickwheel iPods, including the display ,click wheel input and music player.
https://github.com/davidmonterocrespo24/qemu-ipod-classic
Still a work in progress
quotes.zh: 既然是关于老iPod技术，可能你会感兴趣：我一直在让真正的Apple iPod Classic 6G固件在QEMU里跑起来，目前能模拟两个点击轮……
